title: Best robot vacuum deal: Save $80 on Roborock Q7 M5
excerpt: It does it all for a low price.
content_html:
SAVE $80: As of Aug. 6, the Roborock Q7 M5 is on sale for $149.98 at Amazon. That's a 35% discount on the list price.

Credit: Roborock

$149.98 at Amazon
$229.99 Save $80.01

Robot vacuums have become one of the most popular smart home upgrades, and it’s easy to see why. They handle the everyday mess you’d usually have to deal with yourself. So if you've been looking for a deal that makes a purchase even more worthwhile, this Roborock Q7 M5 discount could be the perfect excuse to switch.

As of Aug. 6, it's reduced by $80, bringing the price down to just $149.98. And for under $150, it's by no means a basic machine. In fact, this robot also mops your floors and deals with pet hair.

It uses a 10,000Pa HyperForce suction to vacuum dust and dirt, while the Dual Anti-Tangle Design combines a JawScrapers Comb main brush with a tangle-free side brush to help reduce hair build-up. The mop is detachable, allowing the robot to vacuum and mop simultaneously, and an electronically controlled water tank offers three adjustable water flow levels for different floor types.

Navigation is handled by precise LiDAR, which scans your home to create maps and plan efficient cleaning routes. Once this is done, you can use the Roborock app to schedule cleans, adjust suction and water levels, and set no-go zones.
